title: Tool call
description: The tool_call event: the model asked for one tool, with these arguments, and the adapter is about to hand the call to the host (callTool for a runtime tool, execute for a host tool). Emitted before the call is made, so the host can journal it; its arguments are the model's own, before the host's gate rewrites anything. A host tool with an interaction (ask_user, delegate_tasks) gets no tool_call: it gets user_question or delegation_requested instead. An act call of a tool with a source whose approval policy answers ask gets approval_requested instead (ADR-0008). Read from the AssistantEvent union (web/src/assistant/engine.ts). Open: no reader at run time refuses another member.

callId.description: Pairs the call with its tool_result. The codex engine always sets it (the server's 48-hex call id); the vercel engine sets it on an interactive session, always on an act call of a tool with a source (ADR-0008: its approval decision is tied to the call by it), and always on its refusal of a repeated call or of a call made on the final, tool-free request; never on a call to a tool the model was not offered.

name.description: The tool's declared name, or the output-guarded display name for an undeclared model name (ADR-0017); dispatch still uses the original name. The codex engine offers its tools on the agent wire under aliases (desk_runtime_N, desk_host_N) and reports the real name here. A tool with a source is reported by its wire name, its own name in source.tool (ADR-0006).

args.description: The arguments exactly as the model wrote them. Usually an object; a call to a tool the model was not offered carries whatever the model sent, or {}.

presentation.description: Host-owned presentation frozen when the tool was offered. Added by a host consumer (the research run) from the offered host tool, never by an engine and never from model arguments.

origin.description: harness: the harness made this call itself, not the model: the critic pass's own run of a declared case nothing compared yet (agent#10 review row 8; refutation.ts, compareTheRest). Absent on every call a model made.

source.description: The tool's source record (ADR-0006), on the call of a tool with a source, with tool, its own name there; name is then the wire name the model called. Absent on the Runtime's tools and the host's own.

mcpCall.description: The params of the tools/call frame the host's gate inspects before it leaves the page (web/src/assistant/toolGate.ts, inspectOutboundFrame). Open: the gate keeps other members of params. Its rules: the name must be on this session's allow-list, a subset of the ceiling (tool-offer.json $defs/runtimeCeiling: get_schema, list_examples, get_example, validate, experimental_evaluate, experimental_test_cases), or the frame is refused and a guardrail refused event is emitted; arguments, where present, are an object; experimental_test_cases leaves only with arguments $defs/testCasesArguments admits, or the frame is refused the same way; and experimental_evaluate always leaves with an own rehearsal: true, with a guardrail rewrote event where the model's call did not already carry it. The host keeps this rule; an adapter never applies or skips it.

agentWireCall.description: One tool-call frame's call on the agent wire, from the Desk server to the browser (codexbridge.ToolCall). The browser reader (web/src/assistant/agentTransport.ts) refuses an id that is not 48 lower-case hex digits, a repeated id, more than twenty calls in a run, a name it did not offer and arguments that are not an object; it does not refuse another member.

name.description: The alias the codex engine offered the tool under; the browser refuses any name it did not offer.

testCasesArguments.description: The arguments experimental_test_cases may leave the page with (packages/harness/toolGate.ts, TEST_ARGUMENTS and testArgumentsProblem): exactly the two members the Runtime's served schema names, each a string within its bound, pack at most testPackBytes and matrix at most testMatrixBytes UTF-8 bytes (budget.json, 65536 each by default); the Runtime refuses text that is not JSON. Closed: any other member, a path among them, is refused on the wire with a guardrail refused event, and the model reads a failed result (failure code permission, source tool, outcome not-started) whose detail names the members and sizes, never their text. The call counts against the turn's testCallsPerTurn before the gate sees it.

pack.description: The exact pack under test, as text; the Runtime refuses text that is not JSON.

matrix.description: The matrix, as text: cases, each with an independently established expectation; the Runtime refuses text that is not JSON.

textToolCall.description: One tool call made in text (TextToolCall, extractToolCall in engines/contract.ts; agent#4), on an endpoint whose capability record says it takes no native tool calls (capability.json, nativeToolCalls): the JSON inside the one closed fenced block (```json, then this, then ```) the model's answer carries with a root that names tool. The tools are described at the end of the system text (textToolInstructions) and none is sent on the wire. Closed: an answer with two such blocks, a block that is not JSON, one that carries another member, a tool that is not a name of 1 to 128 characters or arguments that are not an object makes no call; the model is told why (tool-result.json#/$defs/textToolResultMessage) and nothing is run. A call runs through the same dispatch and gate as a native one and emits the same tool_call, guardrail and tool_result events; a name the phase did not offer is refused through the gate, never looked up; on the request reserved for a final answer the call is refused (reserved for a final answer) and the run fails. An answer with no such block is the final answer.
